name: Agent Gateway
description: Deploys the official agentgateway binary as an MCP federation proxy. Port 8080 serves the UI (basic auth) and a Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint multiplexing backends like ha-mcp.

notes.text: Basic auth is not TLS; keep this on a LAN or behind a TLS reverse proxy. Metrics 15020, readiness 15021, and the admin socket on 15000 bind to 127.0.0.1.
Keep one ha-mcp LXC per Home Assistant: the gateway federates endpoints and never sees HA tokens. Do not add the same URLs directly to clients.
UI: http://<ip>:8080/ui (basic auth, user admin). MCP: http://<ip>:8080/mcp/http (also /mcp, /sse), Bearer key or basic auth. Snippet: /opt/agentgateway/mcp_client.json.
Add Streamable HTTP servers in the UI or /opt/agentgateway/config.yaml under mcp.targets (must exist, even empty). Target names: letters, digits, hyphens only.
Config /opt/agentgateway/config.yaml (0600); UI saves strip comments. Restart after config.* or session.key changes. Update: `update` or `pct exec <CTID> -- update`.
Unattended: `var_mcp_targets='home=http://192.168.1.21:8086/mcp-<secret>' var_public_port=8080` (also var_ui_user, var_ui_password, var_api_key) with ct/agentgateway.sh.
